text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Dui, Zhen, Gen... no—Xun! Fortune lies
in the
southeast!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If I can just see the path, my doubts will

disappear! It doesn't matter how strong
my
opponents are!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: RAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: WHOAAAA?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yes! That's what I'm talking about! Did
you see
that?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
This is how I run! ♪ Even against senior
year
runners, I won't budge an inch!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey puts on a magnificent

performance, proving her youthful talent
in the
central dirt G1 race.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
How was it, Trainer? That was probably
my best
run this year, right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You said it! ☆ I almost felt like the wave
of dust
behind me was pushing me
forward!
choice_data_list: Yeah, the good fortune was overflo...
Yeah, you were overflowing with go...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right! If I can keep this up,
I'll only
get even
better next year!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Oh, Tarumae! And Acute, too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae and Wonder Acute
come over
together.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for today! ☆ Our energies must
be in sync,
because I felt super fired up!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae, what did you think of my
running? Do
you think I'll be able to do
well next year?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Your running was...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you'll do well. I do think you'll do
well,
but...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: It's a shame... isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huh? What is?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: What do you mean, Tarumae?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae's eyes are awash with a
sorrowful
glow.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I pushed through blood, sweat, and
tears,
working as hard as I could. Only
now am I finally
able to run like this...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I moved forward in my own way while
keeping my
feet on the ground. But,
your path was... a little
different, Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You spent so much time on things that
aren't
directly related to racing...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It's really impressive that you've come
this far despite that, but I wish that
you'd used your own
time a little more
wisely!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If you'd invested as much into training as
you did into feng shui, your running
would be even more
incredible. You've
got so much potential!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: If you took racing seriously—really seriously, then you'd be able to achieve anything.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to compete against the Rickey
who gave
it her all every step of the
way.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Taru...mae...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her words were like rough ocean waves.
Although
her voice was gentle, it
harbored an undercurrent
of anger.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ah, don't get so worked up, Tarumae.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae... That's not how it is. I haven't
just been
messing around all this time!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I mean, sure, I did a lot of TV stuff,
and I
got
really close to ruining my own
consistency...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: But that's just my way of doing things!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae doesn't respond.
Instead, she
stands there with her lips
tightly pursed, clearly
frustrated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Both of them stay silent. Even Wonder
Acute
doesn't say a word.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Okay, you two. That's enough of that! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You can't be acting like this at the end
of such an
exciting race.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Falco...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Umadols in particular need to remember
the
importance of smiling. Right?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: You're right... I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It's just that... things like feng shui...
They've
never helped me before.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae gives a quick bow of
apology
and leaves. It's obvious that she
had no ill
intentions.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Trainer... I don't think I'm strange.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I just want to use feng shui to make
everyone
happier. And that includes
Tarumae, too.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But maybe others don't see it that way.
Maybe
they just think I'm goofing
around.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I understand both sides of it. But...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Too big?
choice_data_list: Your dream is probably just a litt...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I agree. Look at Tarumae. She tries her
best for
those close to her.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: So maybe she can't quite get your dream of wanting to make everyone happy with feng shui.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It might not seem like it, but she's been
through a lot. She's seen firsthand in the
regionals how relying on things like luck
just doesn't cut it
sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But you know what? She's taken some
detours of her own too. That's what her
singing and dancing
practice as an
Umadol are, right?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So I think she'll come around,
eventually. Don't
let it get to you,
Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That evening...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I think my running got through
to
Tarumae and Acute today. But...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I can say the same about my
feelings.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: This wasn't what I wanted. Not at all.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae's love for her hometown. My
desire to help people with feng shui. We
poured those
feelings into our race, and
they clashed head-on.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I wanted us to compete, acknowledge
each other,
and then finally connect.
That's the kind of race I
wanted to run.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: One more time, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't pull it off today, so I want
another shot!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So I'm counting on you to point me the
right way.
Where's my next race?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're looking for a chance to run
against Hokko
Tarumae again, so we
need to consider what she's
aiming for.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today was one of the two main central
G1 dirt
races. The other one would be...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The February Stakes... A race just as big
as
today's.
choice_data_list: Probably the February Stakes in Fe...
Probably the February Stakes in Fe...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: That's it, then! That's our next goal!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. I want to give it a try,
regardless
of my
fortune. I have to.
choice_data_list: Are you sure you don't need to con...
Aren't you going to check with fen...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
This time, I'm sure I'll get Tarumae to
understand!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey gives herself a morale
boost as we aim for the February Stakes.
Only time will tell if
her words will prove
true.
